title: make tools builds a cs-sandbox that names codesweep-ai images
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach images (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 9)

evidence.verified: In a scratch clone at 8fd7503 whose origin is `git@github.com-fork:forker/campaign.git`, `make tools` built a bin/tools/cs-sandbox whose `version --images` names ghcr.io/forker/sandbox. With origin at https://github.com/codesweep-ai/campaign, it names ghcr.io/codesweep-ai/sandbox. GitHub CI's `ci` passed on 8fd7503, once a macOS smoke job was run again: podman there had refused to start a container.

resolution: `make tools` links the image owner into cs-sandbox, as sandbox's own Makefile does. It reads the owner from origin, SSH host aliases included, so a fork's tiers look for the fork's images.
details: `make tools` installs cs-sandbox at the pin with a plain `go install`, so nothing links in the image owner, and it stays `codesweep-ai`. In a fork workspace, bin/tools/cs-sandbox therefore names `ghcr.io/codesweep-ai/sandbox:<version>` for a version only the fork published, and the tiers boot an image that is not there.
